name: multica
description_en: Make humans and AI agents work as one team — open-source and self-hostable.
readme_excerpt: Multica Agents that show up on the board. Multica is an open-source workspace where you assign work to AI coding agents the way you'd assign it to a teammate — they pick up the issue, report progress, raise blockers, and hand it back for review.
